text:
nina: New contributor reported noisy DEBUG logs and missing req_id in the onboarding sample when OpenTelemetry is enabled. Also saw an email in a header leak.

rahul: Can you paste the repro and a log snippet?

nina: Steps: checkout `onboard/sample-telemetry`, run `./dev up --telemetry`, then `./dev logs`. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-26T08:02:01.100Z INFO app starting
2026-03-26T08:02:01.200Z DEBUG http-client request -> /v1/chat
2026-03-26T08:02:01.201Z DEBUG http-client raw-headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED user-email=bob@example.com
2026-03-26T08:02:01.202Z WARN telemetry req_id missing for outbound call
```

nina: Token redacted but `user-email` leaked. The sample pins `redwood-sdk@0.8.7` and we set `TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first` while experimenting.

rahul: That explains it. Hook ordering changed in 0.9.x so logging injection timing moved. Two short fixes: (1) bump sample SDK to ^0.9.x, (2) add a defensive sanitize pass in the fetch/http-client wrapper to redact email-like and token-like header values before handing off to lower libs.

nina: I tried `REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info` and it reduces noise but node internals still leak a single debug line. A scrub in the wrapper should catch that.

rahul: I'll open a small PR: sample bump + `sanitizeHeaders()` in wrapper + a unit that mocks debug output and asserts no email regex in logs. Also add CI integration that runs with `TELEMETRY_HOOK_ORDER=otel_first` to avoid regressions.

bot-ci: CI queued for branch rahul/telemetry-scrub. Jobs: lint, unit, logs-scan. :gear:

nina: Thanks — please add a one-liner to the quickstart: "If you see noisy DEBUG network logs or missing req_id, set REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL=info or upgrade the sample SDK."

rahul: Will do. Landing scrub behind feature flag REDWOOD_SCRUB_STRICT initially.

nina: Leaving my dev instance running to validate once PR lands. :thumbsup:
